vibe_rationale: City-wide fashion and creativity festival with a vintage strand, but driven by district marketing (1.3 million visits) rather than a scene-run community.
fit_notes: Huge free footfall suits a district installation or a Tokyo Vintage Fashion Week presence, not a deep community play. Sponsorship is sold per district through a published plan page, and beverage and beauty brands (Ito En, Albion) already take part. Tokyo-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
